# GltfReader

Namespace `Nfty.Model` in assembly `Nfty.Model`.

```csharp
public static class GltfReader
```

Reads back the models [`ModelWriter`](Nfty.Model.ModelWriter.md) writes (GLB, glTF + .bin, embedded glTF) and nothing else. It goes through the same record model the writer serializes, so there is one schema; every member that model does not state is refused by name with [`UnsupportedModelException`](Nfty.Model.UnsupportedModelException.md) instead of being skipped, because a skipped feature (a second mesh, a sparse accessor) would show the reader a different model from the file's.

### Read(ReadOnlySpan&lt;byte&gt;) { #m-read-system-readonlyspan-system-byte }

```csharp
public static ReadModel Read(ReadOnlySpan<byte> glb);
```

Reads a GLB held in memory.

**Parameters**

- `glb` (`ReadOnlySpan<byte>`) - The whole file.

**Returns.** The mesh and encoded PNG bytes; no decoded image needs disposal.

**Exceptions**

- [`UnsupportedModelException`](Nfty.Model.UnsupportedModelException.md) - The content is malformed, truncated or outside nfty's supported GLB subset.

### Read(string) { #m-read-system-string }

```csharp
public static ReadModel Read(string path);
```

Reads a model file; the extension (.glb or .gltf) says which.

**Parameters**

- `path` (`string`) - The file. A .gltf's .bin sits beside it.

**Returns.** The mesh and encoded PNG bytes; no decoded image needs disposal.

**Exceptions**

- [`UnsupportedModelException`](Nfty.Model.UnsupportedModelException.md) - The content is malformed, truncated or outside nfty's supported subset, or a referenced companion buffer is missing.

**Remarks**

Ordinary file I/O and permission failures propagate, including failure to open `path` itself. They are not unsupported-content errors.
